messages.author: 09858b6ac9e567bc
messages.subject: individuals' id
parts:
Hello, 
Is there  a way to extract individuals' ids from within the data cross? i would like to keep record of the individuals i have dropped vs. kept during the map construction but cannot seem to identify them by ID as input for the cross formation.
Many thanks in advance!

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: individuals' id
parts:
The function getid() will pull out the individual IDs from a cross object.
If there's no ID column in the phenotype data, getid() returns NULL.

    data(hyper)
    getid(hyper)

    hyper$pheno$id <- paste0("mouse", seq_len( nind(hyper)))
    getid(hyper)

karl
